notes.title: Wagon's Extras #2
notes.content: [h1]Short Story[/h1][p]As previously stated, this game is very inspired by Old Maid. Especially the parts where your friends try to nudge you to pick a certain card by putting in awkward places. It's a fun party game you can do when have playing cards.[/p][p][/p][p]Eventually I had a school project that required me to make a neat little game in a couple months. So I decided to take the parts I like from Old Maid and put it into Witches' Hand. Then take the concept of wild cards from UNO! and I have something fun I would play with some friends and I.[/p][p][/p][h1]Old Stuff[/h1][p]Here's some cards that never made it to this version of Witches' Hand. Which you can find what it does in the manual below, but overall had something to do with changing a players' hand. Which were difficult to implement into my game since this is my first multiplayer game. However, were very funny cards.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629070/7d1822010666dcc5e1b53278fb6a52c85d43445d.png"][/img][/p][h2]Old Manual[/h2][p]Here is a link to an old manual of Witches' Hand![/p][p][url="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Tb37ekoLZ3ikfNrGZ9QNiexa8m0IJ339h2IUgjxgsT0/edit?usp=sharing"]https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Tb37ekoLZ3ikfNrGZ9QNiexa8m0IJ339h2IUgjxgsT0/edit?usp=sharing[/url][/p]

notes.title: Wagon's Extras #1
notes.content:
[h1]Introduction[/h1]
Hello there! I'm Wagon Fish, the developer behind this game. I mostly do what I want. This cool and fun game came about from something I prototyped a while ago in another game. However, I wanted to share my game with my friends. So this a product of me wanting a game for my friends which eventually spiralled into this coming to the steam.

[h1]Further Explanation[/h1]

[h2]Basically[/h2]
You may still be confused on how Witches' Hand plays, but I'll try my best to explain some stuff. When the game starts, players are given lots of cards that will be either of the 10 cards in the game. See the images below for what I mean.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629070/52f7741e868bf90af588ae47af540eb7332b5712.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629070/35e4bc961990837540db7ae06adbae5bac4f6321.png[/img]

In order to win you must be the only player left with health left. In order to accomplish this you want the other players to pull the red cards in your hand, which you can see at the top of your screen. To make the other players pick those cards, you can try moving the cards up and down or rotate the cards left or right. Another method is communicate using the text chat or voice chat of the game. Just do these and you might win the game.

[h2]Furthermore[/h2]

[h2]Take Turns[/h2]
Like most cards games, people take their turns and this time it's being the [b]Puller[/b]. The Puller is in a terrible position as it's their decision that can result in their loss by pulling a red card like above. They must not be fooled by the holders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629070/ddf8dc742b4d33b2c9fc871a36f491588d6d4d90.png[/img]
This is what a puller looks like, located in the bottom of the screen.

[h2]The Cards[/h2]
There are 4 main colors the cards will be. Cards will be a variation of these colors. 

However, simply the red cards are bad if you pull them. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629070/ef92682650effa8df986c6be2ba12a0d0bda2c54.png[/img]

The green cards are good if you pull them. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629070/d8c71d996b06b02651c1632540dce01785aa192d.png[/img]

The brown/orange cards will hurt someone if pulled. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629070/26c5cb58f87a82a5c2782544a130060a8af5bd07.png[/img]

The purple cards will make you pull more cards. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629070/05f7d43357483e666a5357ec8bcd6f9671f9272f.png[/img]

The white card basically does nothing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629070/0a9126ffd03195f89087d396916b239f28725ff6.png[/img]

[h1]Thoughts?[/h1]
If you have any questions or have anything to say, you may comment. I'll try to answer them.
